vsm2.17:3.4: “‘Subject to destruction’ (khaya-dhamma) means that its individual essence is the state of being destroyed (khayana-sabhāva)” (Vism-mhṭ 549). The other expressions are explained in the same way.
vsm2.17:16.2: Paṭicco as a declinable adjective is not in PED. Patīyamāna (“when it is arrived at”): “When it is gone to by direct confrontation (paṭimukhaṃ upeyamāno) by means of knowledge’s going; when it is penetrated to (abhisamiyamāna), is the meaning” (Vism-mhṭ 555). The word paṭicca (due to, depending on) and the word paccaya (condition) are both gerunds of paṭi + eti or ayati (to go back to).
